description:
FOUND s490 (Fable) at the s473t6b review (probe p403.pl line `undef-len`; identical on main ab4da8b4 and on the t6b tree, so PRE-EXISTING and not the batch's).

  no warnings;
  { my $v = -d "/nope-s490"; print defined(length($v)) ? "def" : "undef", "\n"; }     # perl: undef     PCL: def

THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT IS IN HAND -- the emission:

  (p-let (($v :str (%pcl-to-string-strict (p--d "/nope-s490") "$v")))
    (p-print ... (p-defined (p-length $v)) ...))

The variable is a raw `:str` slot: the facts engine decided every use of $v is a string use that cannot observe undef.  `length` CAN: perl's length(undef) is undef (since 5.12), and `length($x) // $default`, `defined length $x` and a list-context `(length $x)` all observe it.  With `defined($v)` ALSO present the slot is not licensed and everything is right (probe q4: A..F identical to perl) -- so the hole is exactly `length` sitting in the undef-insensitive use set.  PCL_OPT=none was NOT measured on this shape (measure it first: if the general-form compiler is right, the fix is one entry in the Kind-A licence; if it is also wrong, the initialiser coercion is the bug).

ALSO PROBE the initialiser half: is a FILETEST's result typed `string`?  It answers 1, "" or undef (and a number for -s / -M / -A / -C), so "always a string" is false for it on its own; find what else shares that result type (the s473t6b #403 fix makes the undef REAL where main had CL NIL).

WHERE: Pl/Passes.pm `raw-slot` / `str-buffer` licence + the use-classification table it reads (grep for the list that names `length`).  Emission-changing (generation bump; corpus-diff will show how many corpus sites carry `:str` slots read only by `length` -- that count is the size of the change).

Low frequency, silent.  Related: #403 (s473t6b), the raw-slot facts (s411 Phase R, Pl/Passes.pm), docs/boxed-aggregates-design-s455.md.

=== DONE (s491a) ===

SHIPPED.  One table entry removed in Pl/VarAnnotator.pm (the task guessed
Pl/Passes.pm -- the licence GATE is there, the use-classification TABLE is in
VarAnnotator's %USE_FN); two stale gate rows repaired and two new ones added in
Pl/t/raw-verdict-01.t (78 rows), the new pair FAILING on an extraction of
337f6a23.

THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT FIRST, as asked (probe
scratch/s491a/probes/p1847c.pl, the task's own reproducer):

    default          A def      <- wrong
    PCL_OPT=none     A undef    <- perl's answer
    PCL_OPT=-raw-slot A undef

So the GENERAL FORM IS RIGHT and the bug is exactly the Kind-A `raw-slot`
licence: `length` sat in the undef-INSENSITIVE string-use set, `my $v = -d
"/nope"` was licensed as a raw `:str` slot, and the initialiser coercion
`%pcl-to-string-strict` froze the undef to "".

THE FAMILY, PROBED (scratch/s491a/probes/p1847fam.perl.out) -- which members of
%USE_FN can answer undef for an undef argument:

  length   UNDEF      <- the only one
  lc uc lcfirst ucfirst substr sprintf   def[""]
  ord hex oct                            def[0]
  index2 split                           def[0]
  index rindex                           def[-1]
  join concat eq                         def[...]

A family of ONE, so the fix is `length`'s ABSENCE from the table, not a new
use class.

THE TASK'S SECOND QUESTION -- is a FILETEST result typed `string`?  No: it
answers 1, "" or undef, and a NUMBER for -s/-M/-A/-C, so "always a string" is
false for it on its own.  But it is NOT a second bug once `length` has left the
set: 8 filetest shapes through the freeze (-d miss, -d hit, -s on a real file,
-s on a missing one, -M, -e, -f, and -s in numeric + boolean context) are
IDENTICAL to perl (scratch/s491a/probes/p1847ft.*).  A filetest's undef and its
"" interpolate and compare alike; only `length` and `defined` could tell them
apart, and `defined` already disqualifies the licence.

SIZE OF THE CHANGE, measured as the task asked: corpus-diff over 111 files =
ONE file moves, perl-tests/readline.t (`my $copy = $k; ... length($copy)`,
where $k is a readline result that can BE undef -- so the move is itself a
fix); emission-ab over the 27 lib shims = ONE, lib/Math/BigInt/Calc.pm (`my
$x_str = $c->_str($x); ... length($x_str)`).  Both lose a `:str` freeze and
gain a box.  RCDIFF 0.

TWO GATE ROWS ENCODED THE OLD BEHAVIOUR (the s416 stale-guard rule, found by
running the targeted gate): raw-verdict-01.t's "string/bool uses: B-str freeze"
and its #1621 interpolation row both carried a `length` read among their string
uses.  Neither was weakened -- in each the length read is replaced by another
REAL string use, so the row still tests what it names -- and two new `unlike`
rows assert the absence with its reason.

PERF: the FIRST version of this fix (length simply absent from the table) made
`my $s=""; $s .= "x"; length($s)` lose its :str-buffer licence too -- MEASURED,
200,000 appends went 0.19 s -> 7.66 s (40x, and QUADRATIC: the bench`s 20 M-append
`strcat` row did not finish).  That is not a 2 % flag, so the fix is narrower:
`length` gets its OWN class `strlen`, which the B-str FREEZE rejects (it loses an
undef initialiser) and `_mark_strbuf` ACCEPTS (a buffer`s only write is `.=`,
which leaves a defined string behind it, so `length` on a buffer sees what perl
sees).  After the carve-out: the reproducer answers `undef`, the strcat emission
is `($s :str-buffer (%pcl-str-buffer ""))` again and 200k appends take 0.16 s.

THE ONE SHAPE STILL DIVERGING, and it is strictly narrower than what it
replaces: a str-buffer whose `.=` NEVER RUNS and whose initialiser is undef
answers `length` 0 where perl answers undef
(`my $s = $h{miss}; $s .= "x" if 0; defined(length($s))`).  Closing it needs
the DECLARATION`s initialiser in _mark_strbuf, which that predicate does not
have today.
subject: SILENT WRONG (pre-existing, facts/raw-slot): `length` is treated as an undef-INSENSITIVE string use, so a `my` whose only uses are `length($v)` is licensed as a raw `:str` slot and an undef initialiser becomes "" -- `my $v = -d "/nope"; defined(length($v))` is DEFINED (0) where perl answers undef
